New controls default to 0. Adjust brightness, frequency and color within AI skin regions while retaining original details.

Enabling any wrinkle control prepares AI repair for that person. Once ready, regional strength changes reuse the cache. All controls default to 0. Eye wrinkles include under-eye lines while protecting eyeballs, lash edges and main hair areas.
Gentle lip-line smoothing uses local tonal smoothing and defaults to 0. It does not use the regional AI wrinkle model above.
